A '''repulsor beam generator''' was a device that generated the power to create a [[repulsor beam]]. The resulting beam was projected via a [[repulsor beam projector]] to create a [[repulsorfield shell]]. The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] used repulsor beam generators on their [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] colonies to protect them from colliding with other asteroids.<ref name="SFS" />
